answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Nobody is waved through free: £44 per docket, and 95 dockets before the first reward is released is the price, and the cipher never covers it twice. The desk only stamps a name that carries Underwritten toll keeper hall warrant, and the stamp itself rests on a warrant keepers carry after toll trials. The jetty is that a hundred names need a hundred tolls, and the farm holds only one purse. Every ripple is counted once.
